summary_1line: Bhishma forms the Sarvatobhadra battle array as both armies advance amid ominous portents, while Arjuna prepares Sikhandin to confront Bhishma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Two vast armies roar forward with conches and drums while Bhishma stands at the front of the Kaurava formation, surrounded by chariots and elephants.
Dark omens fill the sky as meteors fall, jackals howl, and birds circle over the battlefield while the sun grows dim above the assembled armies.
Arjuna speaks to Dhrishtadyumna, pointing toward Bhishma while ordering that Sikhandin be placed before him under Arjuna’s protection.
